hypotheses.justification: `_hb` appears nowhere else in the statement, and the proof never uses it (the underscore name already marks it as unused). The proof needs only three things. First, `recursiveCrossColour_spec` (line 884), which takes just `a b f g hcover x y` and has no hypothesis about `b`. Second, `ha` together with `hactive`, which rule out the forward case: there the colour is `a d ∈ Q`, but `colour ∉ Q`. Third, `b.injective`, which comes from `b` being an embedding. So the existing proof still compiles once the binder is deleted.
